info.name: E-Commerce API Data Validation
info.description:
This collection is created for API Data Validation of an E-Commerce system using Fake Store API.  
It includes Positive and Negative test cases for Products, Cart, Users and Authentication.  
All requests contain proper assertions for Status Code, Response Time, Content-Type and Response Body validation.
